findings.explanation: Payment is due 90 days after the invoice date, which severely delays your cash flow.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a small adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause stating that invoices are payable Net 90, as this delays cash flow, I propose changing the term so that invoices are payable Net 30. Thank you, and I look forward to working together.
